hook.line: Once you truly understand SEO, it will completely change your content's reach.
hook.visual: Woman in a green sweatshirt in front of plants, holding a fidget cube; overlay 'YOU'RE POSTING GOOD CONTENT but nobody is finding you cuz you're not utilizing SEO' with sparkles.

beats.what: Bold claim with the pain-point overlay text across her chest
Cut; 'reply to comment' bubble asking for an SEO tutorial shown
Quick intro: name, four years full-time, top 1% affiliate
Defines SEO and lists everyday search examples
Cut into a screen recording of the TikTok editor: typing keywords in a text box
Shrinks the keyword text and drags it off screen
Voices the viewer's objection ('this sounds like a lot of work')
Proof screen: her video with the search bar TikTok populated above it
Emoji stickers (hug, camera, phone) pop around her as she wraps up

why_it_works: Opening overlay names the viewer's pain ('nobody is finding you') so the claim feels personal
Replying to a viewer comment frames the video as requested, which earns trust and invites more requests
Answers her own predicted objection at 60 s ('how do we know it works?') then shows the search-bar proof
Jump cuts every 3-4 s keep a long tutorial moving
weaknesses: The credential intro (13-22 s) delays the actual tip
Screen recordings are full-frame and quick, so the steps are hard to follow without pausing
112 s is long for one tip and one fallback
for_robert: Have Fred voice the viewer's objection ('this sounds like a lot of work') and let Robert answer it with proof on screen.
